observed_latest.body:
## 目的与结果

这份 PR 将 #173 的 surface-window 优化、macOS 测试辅助修复、分窗口 FTS 重建路径以及原 CI 暴露的 ready 文件发布竞态整合为一份固定候选源码。当前 head 已普通快进到 `c8be5afaac568ffd40ef86d3795423c3b73c9f39`，后续完整验收绑定这一版本。

## 当前固定源码

| 对象 | 提交 |
| --- | --- |
| 产品 P | `35a7b3412e5fdee9e8ff88951735c06b0e371465` |
| 独立审查及原件 R | `a9706a90a72226cb59c3bfd374ef9c1e3d66cbcb` |
| 仅更新原 v15 引用与 registry 的 G | `c8be5afaac568ffd40ef86d3795423c3b73c9f39` |

G 的 tree 为 `9b031be22a430e51e153cce6e80770ed885818e3`。R 是 P 的直接后继，G 是 R 的直接后继。完整清单包含 1,090 个产品输入、139 个验证输入，以及相对固定历史 BASE 的 47 项源码差异。原协议、预算、CI、v14 校验逻辑和 TODO 账本保持原字节；独立薄审也核对了实际 G 对象。

审查及本轮原始工程执行入口：
[`artifacts/checkpoints/p8-ready-signal-bfcc-20261009/`](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/tree/c8be5afaac568ffd40ef86d3795423c3b73c9f39/artifacts/checkpoints/p8-ready-signal-bfcc-20261009/)

## 行为变化与边界

- 保留 #173 的 `reconcile.rs` 原字节，整合已分别审查的 macOS 修复与 FTS 实现/控制。
- 重建路径以至多 256 个文件为窗口延迟写入 FTS 镜像，使用实际存活 rowid 范围，保留冲突幸存者、schema/overflow 回退及错误传播。原公开 `write_file_data` 接口保持原行为；新 opt-in 入口要求调用者传播错误、放弃 staging 并禁止发布失败结果。这里不声称 `journal_mode=OFF` 提供物理回滚，也不把旧原型计时作为本版本的提速证据。
- 本轮只进一步修改 `crates/cc-semantic/tests/crash_independent_review.rs` 的 ready 发布顺序：先在同目录完整写入、sync、close 临时 PID 文件，再 rename 为 ready。保留原 15 秒上限、10ms 轮询、PID 等值、3 seeds × 5 boundaries、SIGKILL、恢复、负例及 OwnedChild 清理。

## 本轮实际工程验证

以下命令在 macOS 26.6.2 arm64、Rust 1.95.0、SDK 15.4 上全部真实退出 0：

| 原命令 | 实际结果 |
| --- | --- |
| `cargo +1.95.0 test -p cc-semantic --locked --all-targets -- --nocapture` | 355 passed / 0 failed / 6 原有 ignored |
| `cargo +1.95.0 fmt --all -- --check` | 通过 |
| `cargo +1.95.0 clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` | 通过 |
| `cargo +1.95.0 test --workspace` | 2,727 passed / 0 failed / 73 原有 ignored |
| `cargo +1.95.0 test -p cc-eval -- integration_fixtures_and_corpus` | 1 passed，属于 workspace 的重复确认 |

实际执行发生在旧 G9f 加 1 个冻结未提交 fixture 修改的工作树，随后与产品 P 做了完整字节、Git blob 和 mode 桥接；不能重标为直接 checkout P/G 的运行。每条命令前后 1,235 个输入不变。15 个原故障边界均实际观察到 SIGKILL 9 和恢复 integrity ok。复用的 APFS clone 依赖缓存属于普通工程验证，不是冷构建证明。

## 已保留的旧版本结果

旧 G `9f7b16f0758eb79f306cf44605b84550f02de441` 的 [P7 closeout run 37896539239](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/actions/runs/37896539239) 真实失败：原 semantic 命令返回 101，`independently_observed_sigkill_boundaries` 读取 ready 时出现 `ParseIntError { kind: Empty }`。日志没有保留实际 seed/PID/系统调用交错，因此不虚构更细的运行现场。[原始日志和 ZIP 保持完整](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/tree/6e7959f5290f1d03e3e5c736e643c4d23a0b6ec7/artifacts/checkpoints/p8-a23-closeout-20261009-bfcc/round10-source-bindings-and-native-outcomes)。

旧 G9f 的既有 Linux v15 CLI 已于 07:36:21 UTC 真实退出 0，期间全部原输入保持不变。该结果只属于旧 G9f，不作为当前 Gc8 的 source admission；旧 G9f 的 runtime/platform 等产物同样单独保存。

## 当前验收与后续

当前 Gc8 的原 CI 和四类 P8 非规模工作流按正常 PR 事件执行。原 CI 已包含 source-integrity suite 与 selected v15 步骤，最终接受时仍核对其实际 checkout 与当前产品、验证和 binding 字节。原规模协议允许这些检查与完整研究并行，不新增本地重复运行或串行等待条件。

Root 正在公开当前 Gc8 的原协议 150 分片 / 1,500 样本预登记，随后只发送一次 workflow_dispatch。5 个原 rep0 全部通过后才执行余下 145 分片，保留原预算、全量 parity 和 strict aggregate；不替换失败主样本。外部 #173 run 37896198208、原 a23 失败研究与 G2 diagnostic 均保留各自身份。

原 TODO 账本仍为 **163 done / 29 remaining，本次新增原任务完成 0**。P8-005–P8-013、P8-016 仅在本版本自身的原执行、独立验收及硬依赖满足后更新。#174/#176 暂保留，待组合版本对应检查通过后按实际继承范围收尾。#175/#179 的新增独立范围保持在其原 PR 中。

关联：#158、#173、#174、#176。

observed_failure.only_established_diagnostic: GitHub reports hosted runner communication loss. Underlying process, kernel, memory, disk and network cause is not established.

raw_inconsistencies_preserved: Failed job is completed while its native step remains in_progress with no end timestamp; later upload/post steps remain pending. These raw fields do not establish the child process state.
Skipped measure job API completed_at is one second earlier than started_at. Original JSON retained without normalization.

matrix_result.accepted_existing_scope: Only previously independently accepted 4/150 shards and41/1500 phase samples. Full study failed/incomplete; no original TODO completion.

deadline_observation.conclusion: Observed wall interval is below all those configured upper bounds. This is not evidence that a registered timeout fired; actual worker monotonic/exit data are missing.

recovery_decision_boundary: No automatic infrastructure exemption or permission to replace failed registered repetition0 was found. Infrastructure classification in 09-BENCHMARK distinguishes invalid measurements; it does not authorize discarding/replacing an original primary.
Do not use rerun-failed-jobs as completion of this old study. Protocol says first slices are original rep0, cannot be removed as smoke or resampled; all150 raw shards remain required.

Workflow artifact names contain run_id but not run_attempt; source records/aggregate do not independently enforce workflow-attempt identity. Mechanical acceptance of a substituted slot would not be protocol permission.

Existing capacity/build/matrix artifact names also create an unresolved rerun name-conflict risk under upload-artifact default immutable semantics. Do not set overwrite or delete original evidence to make a retry fit.

Any root-authorized re-execution used to diagnose runtime loss must use separate diagnostic identity/output, preserve attempt1 failure, retain original workload and budgets, and receive no original study credit.

After a genuinely new reviewed/fixed candidate has its own P/R/G and required engineering checks, root may authorize a separate preregistered full150 study on its exact immutable head/build. It must retain this failed study and cannot import old primary samples as new-source evidence. Same-source fresh investigation is not automatically a replacement certification.
No rerun/cancel/dispatch, budget expansion, source modification or remote mutation was performed during this investigation.
